candidates.change_summary: Replace the max-based unlockTime assignment so _unlockTime is always stored, even if it is in the past.
Replace the balance addition so only msg.value is stored, discarding any prior balance.
Delete the statement that adds msg.value to the stored balance, so deposits are not credited.
Flip the comparison in the unlockTime computation so it stores the minimum instead of the maximum.
Delete the unlockTime assignment so the stored unlock time retains its previous value after a deposit.
Delete the statement deducting the withdrawn amount from the holder's balance, so Collect does not reduce acc.balance.
Replace the low-level call value from _am to acc.balance so Collect sends the entire balance instead of the requested amount.
Replace the revert on failed transfer with a plain return, so a failed transfer keeps the balance deducted (and skips logging) without reverting.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful collections are no longer recorded in the Log history.
Replace the condition block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime with true so the unlock time check is removed and funds can be collected early.
Delete the statement that adds msg.value to the holder's balance.
Replace the balance increment with an assignment that overwrites the balance with msg.value.
Replace the unlockTime update with a plain assignment of _unlockTime, removing the maximum with block.timestamp.
Delete the call that records the Put message in the log.
